query_wording: What changed between the last two publicly available implementation reports for P123456?

turns.user: What changed between the last two publicly available implementation reports for P166685?

text: Last two disclosed ISRs for P166685 (EASP): seq. 9, ISR07389, 17 March 2026, and seq. 10, ISR08554, 14 August 2026.

Ratings: progress towards the PDO stays Moderately Satisfactory; overall implementation progress falls from Moderately Satisfactory to Moderately Unsatisfactory (seq. 9 p. 1; seq. 10 p. 1). Overall risk stays Substantial; the fiduciary risk is proposed up from Substantial to High in seq. 10; sector strategies and institutional capacity remain High, stakeholders Low (seq. 9 p. 2; seq. 10 p. 2).

Results (seq. 9 values of 16 March 2026 vs seq. 10 values of July 2026; seq. 10 pp. 3-4): total connections 534,158 to 612,757 (target 1,571,500); grid connections by Umeme and UEDCL 166,783 to 199,914 (Umeme's 155,088 unchanged since its concession ended; UEDCL 11,695 to 44,826); people with grid access 783,880 to 939,596; people with off-grid access 1,726,663 to 1,940,362; people with clean cooking 572,248 to 873,848; commercial and productive-use beneficiaries 11,058 to 11,722; people in refugee-hosting districts 119,103 to 143,308, of which refugees 30,926 to 35,795.

Disbursement: IDA credit 22.35% to 32.42% (US$72.26m to US$105.35m disbursed); IDA grant 28.89% to 34.08%; CTF grant TF-B5178 40% to 80%; CTF contingent recovery grant still 0% (seq. 9 p. 15; seq. 10 p. 15).

Between the two reports a Level 2 restructuring was approved on 26 June 2026, extending the CTF grants' closing date from 30 June 2026 to 30 June 2027 (seq. 10 pp. 16; key dates in seq. 9 still show 30 June 2026).

Implementation narrative: nearly identical in both ('implementation of grid and off-grid connections, and provision of clean cooking and productive use of energy solutions is underway'); seq. 10 gives no explanation for the downgrade (seq. 9 p. 2; seq. 10 p. 2). The restructuring paper of 18 August 2026, published after seq. 10, attributes the slow grid progress to RBF grid connections and moves US$20 million towards off-grid and clean cooking schemes.

right_sources: Uses the two most recent ISRs by document date (seq. 9 and seq. 10).
grounded: Each change is attributed to the right ISR with values that match; no invented explanation for the rating downgrade.
complete: Covers ratings, risks, results indicators, disbursement and any restructuring between the two.
scoped: Names both ISRs and dates and notes when the reports give no explanation.

notes: A new ISR changes which two are the last two.
